narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one, matching the 3 failures (only rows with both a discount and tax nonzero trip it).
finalText:
**Fixed. `625 total, 625 passing, 0 failing`.**

`orderTotal` in [pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Only rows with both a nonzero discount and tax exposed it, hence just 3 failures.

Next: nothing.
